from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyMetricRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial metric data from a single company report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company the report belongs to")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The name of the financial line item as written in the document")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the line item amount")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g., '元'")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The period covered by this financial data")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_records: list[CompanyMetricRecord]
